perFinding.why: Once the agent can open tickets, the filter needs a new rule: screen create_it_ticket arguments (and the retrieved-document content that produced them) for injected instructions before a side-effecting call is allowed, and exempt tool-call turns with no retrieved chunks from the grounding check so ticket drafts are not flagged as ungrounded.
perFinding.note: Not in key[F2]. Key reasoning (X.F2.wrong) already rejects this: input screening runs on every turn unchanged. Tool-argument validation is the Tool Gateway's responsibility per §6, and the grounding-check exemption is a speculative design concern the architecture does not raise; F2 works without any Guardrail Filter change.

perFinding.why: The grounding check runs unchanged over whatever chunks the Retriever returns; the ACL filtering that makes F5 work lives in the Retriever and Vector Index, so this why describes use, not a change.
